source.name: ESPN MMA public scoreboard (site.api.espn.com), keyless
source.rights: public JSON endpoint, no key, no credits; point-in-time snapshots with attribution — registered source
source.requestCount: ~120 total including the burst the endpoint refused (mechanical receipt: 74-request burst → HTTP 400 'Failed to get events endpoint' on every window; singles fine) — final corpus from 37 windows via the resumable fetcher at 15s spacing + retries
source.windows: monthly Aug 2023 – Aug 2026 (Aug-2026 window ends 08-08: the 08-09 end-date variant is refused by the endpoint; no event occurred on Aug 9, verified against the forward schedule whose next card is Aug 11)

completenessClaim: raw monthly scoreboard responses for three years of UFC cards; bout-level winner flags present; method/round fields NOT captured in this shape (winner-only corpus — stated in the model card); normalization + refusals happen in the corpus builder
